text:
Type: wide clear glass vase
Use: holding a bouquet, branches or decorative fillers on a table or shelf; dining room, living room, kitchen
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, farmhouse
Materials: thick clear glass
Colors: clear transparent glass with a slight cool tint
Shape: squat jar shape with rounded shoulders, wide short neck with a lipped rim, thick heavy base, generous and stable
Feel: fresh, simple, airy, calm
Goes with: fresh flowers, light wood tables, white walls, linen runners; Scandinavian, farmhouse or minimalist rooms
